note: Casefold's own risk typology, in plain words: what a counterparty address belongs to (counterparty) and what went wrong in a case (case). Severity orders them; it is not a score. Programme codes of the sanctions lists map to categories; every listed entity is also 'sanctions'. Based on public sources: the FATF red-flag indicators for virtual assets and the sanctions programmes themselves. label_map: keywords in an explorer's label (Blockscout, Tronscan) that put the address in a category; the first match wins, and the label is always shown with its source.

categories.name: Sanctioned entity
categories.description: On a sanctions list (OFAC, EU, UN, UK). Dealing with it can itself be a violation.

categories.name: Terrorist financing
categories.description: Designated as a terrorist organisation or financier (e.g. OFAC SDGT, FTO; UK and EU counter-terrorism regimes).

categories.name: State-sponsored theft and hacking
categories.description: State actors that steal or launder crypto (e.g. OFAC DPRK programmes).

categories.name: Weapons proliferation
categories.description: Financing of weapons of mass destruction (e.g. OFAC NPWMD).

categories.name: Child sexual abuse material
categories.description: Vendors of child sexual abuse material.

categories.name: Cybercrime and ransomware
categories.description: Ransomware, malware and other cybercrime (e.g. OFAC CYBER programmes).

categories.name: Darknet market
categories.description: Marketplaces for illegal goods.

categories.name: Drug trafficking and organised crime
categories.description: Narcotics and transnational criminal organisations (e.g. OFAC ILLICIT-DRUGS, SDNTK, TCO).

categories.name: Scam and fraud
categories.description: Investment scams, pig butchering, fake platforms, phishing.

categories.name: Stolen funds
categories.description: Proceeds of hacks and thefts.

categories.name: Mixer and obfuscation
categories.description: Services that break the trail of funds.

categories.name: Sanctioned jurisdiction programme
categories.description: Listed under a country programme (e.g. Russia, Iran, Ukraine-related).

categories.name: Human rights abuse
categories.description: Listed under a human rights regime.

categories.name: Election interference and state influence
categories.description: Listed for interference in elections or influence operations.

categories.name: High-risk exchange
categories.description: Exchanges without effective KYC or a licence where they serve customers.

categories.name: Peer-to-peer exchange
categories.description: P2P platforms and OTC desks.

categories.name: Gambling
categories.description: Online gambling services.

categories.name: Exchange (named by an explorer)
categories.description: An address an explorer labels as belonging to an exchange; whether that exchange is licensed is not checked here.

categories.name: Licensed exchange
categories.description: Exchanges with a licence or registration where they operate.

categories.name: DeFi protocol and bridge
categories.description: Smart-contract services, swaps and bridges.

categories.name: Unattributed
categories.description: Not (yet) attributed to a known entity or service.

categories.name: Crypto services without licence or registration
categories.description: Offering crypto services where a licence or registration is required (e.g. Wwft art. 23b, MiCAR art. 59, 18 USC 1960).

categories.name: AML programme failure
categories.description: No effective customer due diligence, monitoring or reporting of suspicious transactions.

categories.name: Sanctions violation
categories.description: Transactions with sanctioned persons or jurisdictions.

categories.name: Money laundering
categories.description: Laundering the proceeds of crime, or a service built for it.

categories.name: Fraud on investors
categories.description: Misleading investors or misusing customer funds.
